figures.Fig14.1: Figure 14.1 Layers of the atmosphere (PDF page 306). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch14-fig-14-1-atmosphere-layers (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure labels the Mesosphere 50-80 km and the Thermosphere 80-600 km, against the book's own text (50-85 km and 85-600 km); drawn with 50-85 km and 85-600 km (correct, as in the text).

findings: Quick Check 14.1 items are used as self-checks of 14.1 and 14.2.
Figure 14.1 as printed gives 50-80 km and 80-600 km, contradicting the text's 85 km boundary; the redrawn figure uses 50-85 km and 85-600 km and the Roman Urdu lesson explains the correction.
